project_title: JEELIVE.AI Learning Dashboard - Specific Exam Card Glossy Red & Glossy Orange Refinement

brand_identity.positioning: High-Performance Competitive Exam Preparation Platform for JEE Main, BITSAT, & COMEDK
brand_identity.archetype: Performance Pro & Old Money Tech Fusion
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Precision, Elite Academic Confidence, High-Contrast Energy

glossy_card_reflection.css_keyframes: @keyframes shiningSweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-150%) rotate(25deg); } 100% { transform: translateX(150%) rotate(25deg); } }

accessibility_and_contrast.wcag_level: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text over glossy red and glossy orange backgrounds)
accessibility_and_contrast.focus_states: ring-2 ring-red-400 ring-offset-2 on JEE Main card; ring-2 ring-orange-400 ring-offset-2 on BITSAT card
accessibility_and_contrast.reduced_motion: Respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) by disabling animated shine translation

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In /app/frontend/src/learning-workspace.css, refine .exam-tone-jee-main to use a rich Glossy Red palette (#991B1B / #7F1D1D) with high-contrast readable white text (#FEF2F2) and ruby glowing borders.
2. Refine .exam-tone-bitsat to use Glossy Orange palette (#EA580C / #C2410C) with warm radiant amber glow and orange-tinted contrast text (#FFF7ED).
3. Keep .exam-tone-comedk (Obsidian Black) and Flagship All India Blue (#0B2D80) completely untouched as requested by the user.
4. Ensure layout, links, exam rules, and streak trackers remain 100% intact.
5. Ensure all interactive card elements have appropriate data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts and cheap gradients. Use crisp borders, layered z-indices, and optical alignment.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never use transition: all. Use targeted CSS properties like transition-transform or transition-colors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers or cards where content scrolls underneath; use backdrop-blur and glassmorphism styling.
